main_text.head: VIRO CLARISSIMO, PIO, CONSVLTISSIMOQ. DN. IOAN. LVDOVICO ISELIO BASILIENSI, Iuris utriusq; Doctori & Professori in Academia Basilienfi celeberrimo; EX ILLVSTRI AMERBACHIORVM FAMILIA oriundo, eiusdemq; ornamento maximo; Domino & Sympatriotae suo eximie honorando; φιλίας [?] καὶ φιλοσοφίας [?] LEO ἀπραξίας τε [?] ὑγίειαν.

p.i: Tot tantaq; beneficia, Illustris & Cl. D. Doctor, à Magnifico & summo illo ERASMO ROTERODAMO, studiorum optimorum fautore & Mecœnate incomparabili, per vestram splendidissimam Familiam in me hucusq; collata sunt, & quotidie conferuntur, ut dignissimus sane essem, qui exularem ab omni penitus humanitate, si non ego vicissim vel animum (si plurib. pro tempore nō licet) gratum saltem & benevolum benefactorib. declarem. Et proin tibi etiā, mi D. Doctor Iseli, hæcce Medico-iuridica offerenda duxi, debitæ observātiæ, amoris & gratitudinis meæ erga familiā quoq; vestrā signū & μνημόσυνον. Quæ ut sereno & candido animo suscipias, excipias & tuearis, ac Leonem porrò tuum, tibi in perpetuum devinctum, siquidem dignum ducis, ut abs te ametur, redamare ut incipias, vel potius pergas, rogo. Etiam atq; etiam, vale.

page.notes: Greek line "φιλίας [?] καὶ φιλοσοφίας [?]" and "ἀπραξίας τε [?] ὑγίειαν." are uncertain in the ornamental symbols and accents; the word "Medico-" is hyphenated at the line end and joined here. "ROTERODA / MO" has no printed hyphen and is written whole. The body text is set in italic throughout; the abbreviation "nō" is copied with its macron as printed.
